title: Not Eligible | EU 261 | Employee OAL
description:
OAL (partner airline) employee travelling on staff booking on an EU route (LHR?YYZ). Despite a 4hr controllable delay on a route where both EU 261 and APPR apply, the OAL employee exclusion overrides all regime assessments. Validates that the employee exclusion is universal � it blocks eligibility under EU 261 just as it does under APPR.

Prerequisites:
PNR: single passenger (Adult). Employee Flag: OAL EMPLOYEE BOOKING � partner airline staff travel flag in Trip Tracer. Journey: 1 leg AC operated, Flight AC 850, LHR?YYZ. Scheduled arrival: 16:00. Actual arrival: 20:00 (4hr delay). Arrival Delay code: 42 ( Controllable). Arrival code: 42 (available, no fallback). Regime: EU 261 (UK origin) + APPR (Canada arrival). Timing: >72hrs elapsed. Filing: Within limitation.
